schema_rule.header_detection: If the first field is the canonical text header, parse normally. Otherwise parse the first row as data using the fixed canonical column names and require the exact expected column count.
schema_rule.integrity: The raw nested ZIP SHA-256 must still match the retained FILE_MANIFEST before parsing. No value repair, gap fill, row deletion or timestamp substitution is allowed.
